replay_metadata.name: August 2026 Severe Summer Storm
replay_metadata.description: Documented held-out test disturbance during peak summer thermal stress. High water temperature (26.5°C) combined with a rapid 26.5 mm rainfall surge and discharge crest of 4,910 cfs drove dissolved oxygen down by 1.45 mg/L to an acute trough of 5.65 mg/L.

forecast_generated_at_t0.forecast_status: Valid — Inputs within Delaunay convex hull

action_window_forecast.empirical_basis: 58 historical storm lag distributions at USGS 01474500
action_window_forecast.operational_deadline_warning: Nadir expected within 6.5 to 18.0 hours. Interventions requiring >6h mobilization must commence immediately.

intervention_rehearsal.assumptions_disclaimer: Oxygen benefit calculated via Streeter-Phelps continuous mass balance. UNVALIDATED SCENARIO: Field treatment magnitude not experimentally confirmed.

verification_and_error_evaluation.early_warning_narrative: The true storm minimum DO fell to 5.65 mg/L (a severe drop of 1.45 mg/L). Persistence completely missed the drop (error: 1.45 mg/L), while the ML model anticipated the depression within 0.40 mg/L. The threshold was NOT breached (5.65 > 5.0 mg/L), confirming the model's <20% risk assessment.

operational_constraints: Requires on-site electrical power or diesel generator refueling logistics.
Navigational clearance permits required for surface-mounted aerators in commercial river channels.
Limited spatial reach: effective primarily within 1-3 km of injection point.
